title: CAE-DFKD: Bridging the Transferability Gap in Data-Free Knowledge Distillation
problem: Existing data-free knowledge distillation (DFKD) methods focus on image-level recognition performance without addressing transferability of learned representations to downstream tasks.
motivation: Knowledge distillation requires access to training data; DFKD enables distillation without real data, but poor representation transferability limits deployment to new domains.
method: Proposes Category-Aware Embedding DFKD (CAE-DFKD) that operates at the embedding level rather than image level; alters generator training paradigm to improve representation quality and downstream task transfer.
key_novelty: Embedding-level knowledge distillation approach that prioritizes representation transferability over image-level metrics.
contributions: Category-aware embedding formulation for data-free knowledge distillation
Efficient generator training paradigm reducing computational overhead
Demonstrated state-of-the-art DFKD performance on image recognition with improved downstream task transferability
limitations: Not discussed—focus on embedding-level design without hardware constraints or scalability analysis.
primary_theme: Embedding-level knowledge distillation for improved transferability
